faq_title_before: Everything You Need To Know Before Getting Started With
faq_1_q: What is the minimum investment to get started?
faq_1_a:
The initial investment includes the cost of the machine, site infrastructure (solar power, satellite, security, construction) and working capital. As a guideline, starting with 1 ATM requires approximately 27.6 M XAF, including recommended working capital. Pack 3 ATM formulas offer significant preferential conditions.

Each project is unique. Contact our team for a personalized financial simulation based on your configuration.
faq_2_a:
The distribution applies to net profit after deducting all expenses. The franchisee receives the majority share, MobileWallet retains a share for technology and support, and a share goes to the super-franchisee for local coordination. The model is transparent and contractually defined from the start.

The exact structure depends on the chosen partnership model. Contact our team for a revenue projection adapted to your situation.
faq_3_q: Which Mobile Money operators are compatible?
faq_3_a:
The platform is multi-operator and integrates MTN Mobile Money, UBA M2U, Orange Money, Wave, Sara Money, Afriland, etc. This multi-operator capability maximizes your revenue: each additional operator connected to your ATM directly multiplies your turnover.

Available operators vary by country. Contact our team for active integrations in your area.
faq_4_q: How is maintenance and technical support ensured?
faq_4_a:
MobileWallet handles software maintenance, 24/7 monitoring, dedicated technical support, secure cash logistics and comprehensive machine insurance. As a franchisee, you track your performance via your dashboard—no technical skills required.

Maintenance conditions vary by partnership model. Our team will detail the terms for your project.
faq_5_q: Is it possible to integrate the system with our existing ATMs?
faq_5_a:
Yes. If you already have a fleet of ATMs from NCR, Diebold Nixdorf, Hyosung or Kiosk, MobileWallet can connect them to its platform via API integration. You then benefit from the operator network, dashboard and 24/7 support without changing your machines.

Compatibility depends on the model and configuration of your machines. Contact our team for an audit of your existing fleet.
faq_6_q: What is the delivery and installation time for an ATM?
faq_6_a:
From order to commissioning, expect generally 6 to 12 weeks. This includes shipping, customs clearance, site preparation, installation of equipment (solar power, satellite, camera) and software configuration. Full training is provided at commissioning.

Each project being unique, contact our team for a personalized schedule.
faq_7_q: Is the software certified to banking security standards?
faq_7_a:
Yes. The platform is developed according to banking industry standards: end-to-end encryption, KYC/AML compliance, regular audits and ANTIC certification in Cameroon. Machines are physically secured with 24/7 surveillance and armored cash transport.

Certifications vary by country. Our team accompanies you in local regulatory procedures.
faq_8_q: Do I need a banking license to become a franchisee?
faq_8_a:
No. MobileWallet handles all regulatory compliance, Mobile Money operator connections and security protocols. Your role focuses on locations and capital. No technical or banking expertise required.

For deployment in a new country, our team accompanies you in local regulatory procedures.
